proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG / GENERAL FUND APPROPRIATIONS / SUMMARY & CLASSIFICATION OF ACCOUNTS / FISCAL YEAR 2017`, PDF pages 24-28 of the FY2017 annual town report. THE PAGE CARRIES ITS OWN TEXT LAYER -- pdfplumber returns 317/284/276/278/306 words on pages 24/25/26/27/28 and the pages hold no image at all -- so this is read, not recognised, and the OCR reading of these pages is discarded rather than reconciled. THE PRINTED HEADER, read off every one of the five pages and identical on each, is two lines: `PROGRAM NAME | APPROPRIATED | TOTAL FUNDS | TOTAL | TOTAL | BALANCE TO` over `FORWARD | AVAILABLE | EXPENDED | ENCUMBERED | REVENUE`. The five money columns are right-aligned and their right edges cluster at x1 306-313, 375-383, 433-442, 485-488 and 533-539 with no overlap; all 798 money tokens on the five pages land in a column and none is unplaced. 183 leaf rows (line items plus the 36 fwd/srt/rft carry-forward lines, which are lines OF the column -- the heading is APPROPRIATED *FORWARD* and every department subtotal includes them). FOUR INDEPENDENT IDENTITIES CLOSE TO THE CENT: (1) the printed GRAND TOTAL on page 28, TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE $37,626,445.44; (2) TOTAL EXPENDED $36,739,086.52; (3) TOTAL ENCUMBERED $675,368.25; (4) 90 of 90 rows that print BALANCE TO REVENUE satisfy available - expended - encumbered = balance, the GRAND TOTAL row among them. The page's own footer legend gives two more: `srt - Salary Reserve Transfer $38,689.26` is the sum of the 9 lines marked srt, exactly, and `rft - Reserve Fund Transfer $29,993.00` is the single line so marked. THE ONE COLUMN THAT DOES NOT CLOSE IS ATTESTED, NOT TOLERATED: APPROPRIATED FORWARD sums to $37,626,083.44 against a printed $37,626,445.44, short exactly $362.00, and the legend `fwd - forward from FY 2016 $637,981.43` is short by the SAME $362.00 against the 26 fwd lines printed. Both point at one block, Police Fire Medical Expenses on page 25: the item row prints $5,000.00 APPROPRIATED FORWARD and $5,362.00 TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE, and its own subtotal row prints $5,362.00 in BOTH columns -- so the document requires a $362.00 carry-forward line that it does not print. Confirmed by eye on a 300dpi render of pages 25 at y 460-580: the line above `Police Fire Medical Expenses`, where every other group prints its fwd/srt marker, is BLANK. THIS IS THE TOWN'S OWN ARITHMETIC DISAGREEING WITH ITSELF, not a misread, and an extractor that made it close would be wrong.
